description: The canonical seven-overlay diagnostic and transmission layer system for TriadicFrameworks. Applies six diagnostic overlays sequentially — Structural → Drift → Coherence → Substrate → Dimensional → Domain — then passes every emitted payload through the cross-cutting Clarity Overlay (⑦) before final transmission. Produces the Domain Diagnostic Report (DDR), Domain Action Map (DAM), and Cross-Domain Causality Summary (CDCS). Coordinates all 15 RTT engines, 17 modules, and 27 UI overlay panels. Clarity Overlay gates transmission at Ξ ≥ 0.70.
role: Pack coordinator — orchestrates the six-overlay diagnostic sequence plus Clarity transmission gate; canonical entry point for all S3 Spine runs
purpose: Seven-overlay canonical diagnostic and clarity layer system: Structural → Drift → Coherence → Substrate → Dimensional → Domain → [Clarity gate Ξ ≥ 0.70]; produces DDR, DAM, CDCS; coordinates all RTT engines and UI overlays
exports: Clarity Report (Ξ, regime, repair path) — gated at Ξ ≥ 0.70
imports: Receiver profile set G₁…G₅ (for Clarity Overlay)
